data.title: Gold rises from 14-month low as markets await key US inflation data
data.description:
Key points:
  • US PCE data due on Wednesday
  • Silver climbs 4%
  • Fed's Cook says current US policy rate not high enough to tackle inflation

By Sukanya Mitra

Gold regained some ground on Monday after falling to a 14-month low last week, with investors weighing the deep selloff in US equities against upcoming US inflation data for fresh clues on the trajectory of interest rates.

Spot gold climbed 2.9% to $3,635.80 per ounce by 0721 GMT. Bullion fell about 9% last week, its steepest weekly decline since March.

US gold futures gained 3.4% to $3,635.10.

"The selloff in tech stocks and the expectations of weaker economic activity because of the weaker AI boom have led the markets to reprice the path forward for US interest rates, which has provided gold with some fundamental support," said Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com.

Markets continued to price in a December Fed rate hike of 25-basis-point, while expectations for a larger 50-basis-point increase were fully priced out, according to CME's FedWatch tool.

Lower odds of higher rates reduce the opportunity cost of holding bullion, enhancing the appeal of the non-yielding asset.

"Despite a modest rebound in early trading today, we still need to be cautious to call a bottom in gold. We also cannot rule out further forced liquidation if volatility in equity markets persists," said Dilin Wu, research strategist at Pepperstone.

US stock futures rose while authorities scrambled to shore up sliding stock markets in Asia, after a wipeout last week for the tech and chip stocks at the centre of the AI boom.

Fed Governor Lisa Cook made a case for more rate hikes on Friday, saying the Fed's current policy rate was not high enough to deal with inflation levels she viewed with "great concern."

Market participants now await the US Personal Consumption Expenditures data due on Wednesday, a key gauge closely watched by the central bank as it targets a 2% inflation rate.

Spot silver climbed 4.1% to $42.86 per ounce, platinum gained 2% to $1,324.43 and palladium rose 1.7% to $908.18.

data.title: Ujjivan SFB hits ₹12,000 crore housing milestone, hosts industry conclave
data.description:
Ujjivan Small Finance Bank crossed ₹12,000 crore in its Housing and Micro Mortgages portfolio, the Bengaluru-based lender announced on November 23, 2026. To mark the occasion, the bank hosted an industry conclave titled ‘Building Bharat – Brick by Brick’, focused on the future of affordable housing finance in India.

The event featured a keynote by Sanjay Shukla, Managing Director of the National Housing Bank (NHB), who noted that while Small Finance Banks account for 1.3 per cent of housing loans by value, they represent 5.6 per cent by number of accounts, underlining their outsized role in financial inclusion. He stressed the need for patient funding, supportive policy and digital solutions to widen access.

Interim CEO Carol Furtado said the milestone reflects customer trust and the bank’s commitment to expanding housing finance access, citing significant growth potential in rural housing and first-time homeownership. ICRA’s Ashish Modani described housing as a strong secured-lending segment with potential for sustained double-digit growth, backed by historically low credit losses. NHB’s Vishal Goyal pointed to India’s mortgage-to-GDP ratio of around 12 per cent, with room to reach 18–20 per cent over five years.

At the conclave, Ujjivan announced a partnership with GRIHA Council to help affordable housing customers build green-certified homes and received its first green housing certificate. The bank also runs the Ujjivan Aarogya Ghar initiative with Water.org, raising awareness on safe water and sanitation.

Ujjivan’s housing business began as a pilot in 2015 and now spans 23 states and union territories. The bank was the first Small Finance Bank to access NHB-linked funding, receiving ₹1,540 crore in refinance, and has supported over 12,000 families under PMAY-G 1.0. Its average housing loan ticket size stands at ₹12–13 lakh.

As of September 30, 2026, Ujjivan’s gross loan book stood at ₹45,699 crore, with deposits of ₹50,643 crore.

data.title: Ionic Wealth raises ₹177 crore, pushes AUM past ₹16,000 crore
data.description:
Ionic Wealth by Angel One, a Mumbai-based tech-driven wealth management platform, has raised ₹177 crore in a fresh funding round from parent company Angel One and a group of marquee families, bringing its cumulative capital raised to approximately ₹466 crore.

The platform, which commenced operations in 2024, has grown rapidly. Its assets under management surged more than fourfold, from roughly ₹3,800 crore in March 2025 to over ₹16,000 crore as of September 2026. Its HNI and UHNI client base nearly quadrupled during the same period, rising from around 680 to over 2,900 clients across 12 cities, supported by a team of over 100 private bankers.

The fresh capital will be deployed to strengthen Ionic’s portfolio-led proposition, deepen AI integration in its wealth-tech platform, scale its UHNI business, advance GIFT City-based global investing, and expand its footprint domestically and internationally.

Co-founder and CEO Srikanth Subramanian said the investment validates the firm’s vision of building a wealth platform that combines domain expertise with technology. Angel One founder Dinesh Thakkar cited India’s wealth management industry as being at a significant inflection point, driven by rising affluent investor numbers and increasingly sophisticated financial needs.

All investors from the previous funding round also participated in the current raise, which includes business families, fintech entrepreneurs, global executives, and media houses.

data.title: Intellect bets on AI platforms Purple Fabric and MSOCK to drive next phase of growth
data.description:
Purple Fabric clocks ₹200 crore in revenue, contributes 8% to Intellect’s topline

Intellect Design Arena’s decision to carve out its AI platform offerings, Purple Fabric, as a separate unit and subsequently launch the AI-native engineering system MSOCK is bringing in results, as the firm currently counts 40-50 customers working with Purple Fabric. Similarly, MSOCK has generated 70 customer conversations within just 60 days of its launch.

Purple Fabric already contributes around ₹200 crore in revenue (7-8 per cent of total revenue) while the more recently launched MSOCK could have a revenue potential of up to ₹1000 crore, Arun Jain, CMD, Intellect Design Arena, told businessline in an interaction.

Purple Fabric is an enterprise AI platform, primarily for banking and financial services entities, that lets them build and run specialized AI agents to automate work and make decisions using their own data. MSOCK, on the other hand, acts as a ‘context layer’ by integrating all enterprise information, including old databases, documents, legacy tech systems and traditional business logic.

“The sales are doing very well. Decision cycles are slightly longer because the platform is still at an early stage and customers often have that buy versus build dilemmas. But a lot of good conversations are happening and many customers are already signed up,” Jain said. He also noted an investment of ₹100 crore every year in Purple Fabric.

MSOCK could drive bigger growth over next 24 months

He believes MSOCK will be the bigger revenue driver over the next 24 months and could prove to be the ‘Trojan horse’ for the Chennai-based software product company to land bigger BFSI customers.

On queries of revenue cannibalisation with Intellect’s current products, Jain said the products are more complementary than competitive.

“A lot of people have a challenge in modernisation...First, we will use MSOCK as a knowledge harness for them to understand the legacy systems. After this, when they want to modernise and migrate to a new system, you take eMACH and our other offerings,” he said.

AI platforms target large financial services market

Deepak Dastrala, CEO of Purple Fabric, believes the market size for a knowledge harness like MSOCK is extremely large and needed across every kind of financial institution.

“Even for the best of the banks, the technology spend is anywhere between 11 to 17 per cent, but their operational spend is between 40 to 46 per cent,” he said, speaking of the need for Purple Fabric. Intellect’s pedigree in building products for a highly regulated industry such as banking will prove to be a differentiator, he added.

Intellect explores acquisitions to expand AI reach

Meanwhile, Intellect is also eyeing acquisitions to expand the geographic reach of its AI products.

Jain said they are evaluating markets where it has little or no existing presence, such as Latin America, parts of Europe, Japan and South Korea. “We are looking to see if we can have legacy companies who already have customers in these geographies so that we can approach these,” he said.

Q2 revenue rises 12 per cent

Intellect posted revenues of ₹847 crore for the second quarter ending September 2026, up 12 per cent year-on-year from the previous year. Net profit stood at ₹104 crore as against ₹102 crore.

The duo also said that while separating the AI business ,such as Purple Fabric, into a standalone company could be considered in the future, there are no immediate plans to spin it off.

data.title: IT holds firm as banks, metals drag Nifty below 25,600
data.description:
Benchmark indices reversed their morning gains sharply by midday Monday, with the Sensex trading at 82,926.09, down 993.62 points or 1.18 per cent, and the Nifty 50 at 25,507.05, falling 293.55 points or 1.14 per cent, as of 12.30 pm. Both indices had opened with a gap-up, the Sensex at 84,421.97 and the Nifty at 25,929.15, before selling pressure erased all gains and pushed them into negative territory.

The mid-session reversal was broad-based, with 2,692 stocks declining on the BSE against 1,547 advancing and 270 unchanged, out of 4,509 stocks traded. The advance-decline ratio on the Nifty stood at 16:34. A total of 213 stocks hit the lower circuit, against 167 in the upper circuit. Meanwhile, 129 stocks touched 52-week lows, slightly more than the 122 that hit 52-week highs.

Banking stocks bore the brunt of the sell-off. Axis Bank fell 2.79 per cent to ₹1,405.70 from a previous close of ₹1,446, on volumes of 76.08 lakh shares worth ₹1,076.92 crore. HDFC Bank dropped 2.31 per cent to ₹826.45 from ₹846, with a heavy turnover of 360.85 lakh shares amounting to ₹3,018.67 crore, among the highest by value on the exchange. The Nifty Bank index declined more than 1 per cent, reflecting broad weakness across private sector lenders.

Metals continued to slide. Tata Steel was the steepest loser on the Nifty 50, plunging 8.20 per cent to ₹163.40 from a previous close of ₹178, on massive volumes of 1,064.26 lakh shares worth ₹1,781.47 crore. Hindalco fell 2.14 per cent to ₹909.60 from ₹929.50, with 71.25 lakh shares traded worth ₹648.28 crore. Tata Motors’ passenger vehicle subsidiary (TMPV) declined 2.05 per cent to ₹260.90 from ₹266.35.

IT stocks bucked the trend, with the Nifty IT index gaining over 1 per cent. TCS was the top gainer on the Nifty 50, rising 3.18 per cent to ₹2,451.80 from ₹2,376.20, with an unusually high volume of 45.37 lakh shares worth ₹1,119.02 crore. Tech Mahindra gained 2.40 per cent to ₹1,788.10 from ₹1,746.20, on volumes of 20.93 lakh shares worth ₹375.20 crore. Shriram Finance rose 3.05 per cent to ₹1,001.65 from ₹972, with 68.17 lakh shares traded worth ₹679.96 crore. Maruti Suzuki added 1.71 per cent to ₹14,251 and Apollo Hospitals gained 1.20 per cent to ₹9,310.

On the technical side, SBI Securities flagged 25,410–25,430 as a crucial support zone for the Nifty, with resistance at 25,720–25,740. A slip below 25,410 could expose the next support band of 25,240–25,260. Options data reinforced caution, with meaningful call writing at the 25,600 and 25,700 strikes, while the 25,500 put held substantial open interest.

In commodities, WTI crude traded around $83.20, down approximately 0.5 per cent, while the Indian rupee strengthened marginally to around 92.56 against the dollar, extending its recent run of lower closes. COMEX Gold held around $3,600, up roughly 2.5 per cent, recovering from its steepest weekly fall in eight months. MCX Gold was up approximately 1.9 per cent at ₹1,24,120, while MCX Silver outperformed at ₹1,51,450, up around 2.5 per cent.

The session’s ability to hold the 25,500 mark on the Nifty and 82,700 on the Sensex, cited as key supports, will likely determine whether broader selling accelerates into the second half of the session. With November F&O expiry falling today and global risk sentiment remaining fragile after last week’s sharp US technology-led selloff, traders will watch institutional flows and crude price moves closely through the afternoon.

data.title: TRUST Mutual Fund names Anup Seth as CEO, Bagla moves to group role
data.description:
TRUST Mutual Fund has appointed Anup Seth as its Chief Executive Officer with effect from November 20, 2026, the asset management company announced on Monday.

Seth joins from Edelweiss Life Insurance, where he served as Director and Chief Distribution Officer, overseeing distribution, strategy, marketing and digital initiatives. He brings over 26 years of experience across financial services, retail and digital platforms. Prior to Edelweiss, he held senior roles at Reliance Nippon Life, HDFC Life, IDBI Federal Life and Future Group, and was a co-founder of digital venture Inmatch Internet Ventures.

Outgoing CEO Sandeep Bagla, who has led the fund house since inception, moves to TRUST Group as President — Strategy & Synergies. The company credited Bagla with establishing TRUST Mutual Fund as a fast-growing player in the Indian mutual fund industry.

Seth’s stated priorities include widening the investor base, strengthening multi-channel distribution, refining the product mix, and expanding the brand and partnership ecosystem. The fund house indicated it aims to deepen retail participation and extend its reach beyond major cities.

TRUST Mutual Fund is sponsored by Trust Investment Advisors Private Limited and managed by TRUST Asset Management Private Limited. Its parent, TRUST Group, was founded in 2001 and operates across debt capital markets, wealth management, portfolio management and alternative assets.

data.title: Smith+Nephew Appoints Nick Alexos As CFO
data.description:
LONDON (dpa-AFX) - Smith & Nephew plc (SN.L), a medical technology business, Monday announced that it has appointed Nick Alexos as its Chief Financial Officer, effective November 30.

Alexos has more than 35 years of financial, commercial and transaction experience and was most recently, finance chief at Univar Solutions, a distributor of chemicals and ingredients from 2020 till 2026.

Prior to this, he was the Chief Financial Officer and Chief Administrative Officer of dental technology business Dentsply Sirona. Prior to Dentsply Sirona, Nick spent 30 years at private equity firm Madison Dearborn Partners.

data.title: TotalEnergies deepens U.S. gas tie-up with Continental, eyes 850 MMscf/d U.S. gas output by 2032
data.description:
Key points:
  • TotalEnergies has signed a new agreement with Continental Resources, under which TotalEnergies acquires interests in natural gas upstream assets. The transaction is expected to add approximately 150 MMscf/d1 (equivalent to around 26 kboe/d) to TotalEnergies’ net gas production in the United States by 2032.
  • “This transaction will strengthen our natural gas production in the United States and consolidate TotalEnergies’ integrated position from upstream gas production to LNG exports,” said Nicolas Terraz, President of Exploration & Production at TotalEnergies .
  • The transaction with Continental Resources builds on previous acquisitions of non-operated interests completed in 2025 in the Anadarko Basin with Continental Resources and in 2024 in the Eagle Ford play with EOG Resources and Lewis Energy.
  • These assets will offer low-cost, low-emission, long-plateau production and are well connected to existing midstream infrastructure. Together with TotalEnergies’ operated Barnett asset, they are expected to bring the company’s overall net natural gas production in the U.S. to approximately 850 MMscf/d2 (equivalent to more than 140 kboe/d) from 2032 onwards.
  • TotalEnergies has invested in a number of major LNG projects in the U.S. including Cameron LNG and Rio Grande LNG. TotalEnergies also off-takes LNG from major U.S. terminals, such as Sabine Pass LNG, Freeport LNG, and Corpus Christi LNG.

data.title: Bavarian Nordic – Transactions in Connection with Share Buy-Back Program
data.description:
COPENHAGEN, Denmark, November 23, 2026 – Bavarian Nordic A/S OMX:BAVA announces transactions under the share buy-back program launched on November 13, 2026, under which the Company will repurchase shares for an amount up to DKK 250 million in the period from November 13, 2026 to January 15, 2027. The program is executed in accordance with Regulation (EU) No. 596/2014 (as amended) of the European Parliament and of the Council on market abuse and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1052, which together constitute the Safe Harbour Regulation.

Since initiation of the program, the following transactions have been made by Danske Bank on behalf of Bavarian Nordic:

 Number of sharesAverage purchase price, DKKTransaction value, DKK
November 13, 2026 33,000 239.48 7,902,840
November 16, 2026 33,000 239.41 7,900,530
November 17, 2026 31,000 241.80 7,495,800
November 18, 2026 30,000 242.97 7,289,100

Accumulated under the program187,000242.2645,301,950

The details for each transaction made under the share repurchase program are published on bavarian-nordic.com.

Following these transactions, Bavarian Nordic holds a total of 4,851,037 treasury shares, corresponding to 6.12% of the Company’s share capital.

About Bavarian Nordic

Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com
